studio.title: Cast & LoRA Studio
studio.intro: Create characters, manage their training data, generate a reference sheet, and train a LoRA — all in one place. Pick a subject to open its studio.

errors.makeDefaultFailed: Could not make this the default.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load this cast member.
errors.noRefsForSync: Upload reference photos on Training Data first, then sync identity from photos.
errors.syncFailed: Sync identity from photos failed (is Ollama up?).
errors.planFailed: Planning failed (the LLM may be offline).
errors.trainBaseNotReady: Train base not ready for this model.

overview.syncConfirm: Sync identity from photos rewrites the identity bible, replacing your unsaved edits to it. Continue?
overview.triggerHelp: Rare token the LoRA trains on; every prompt must include it. Blank → uses the name.
overview.descriptionHelp: Optional brief for FilmCrew / script invent only. Not used for Cast generate when reference photos exist.
overview.bibleHelp: Appearance from your photos — vision describes what it sees (human, animal, costume, …) and keeps the consistent details. Used for base (no-LoRA) generates; with a trained LoRA, generate uses trigger + short marks only. Train does not rewrite this.
overview.manualEditWarning: Manual edit — use <bold>Sync identity from photos</bold> to re-ground from refs.
overview.mismatchWarning: Bible may not match your photos — use <bold>Sync identity from photos</bold> so Generate / captions stop inventing a different look.
overview.bibleManual: Manual edit — Sync identity from photos to re-ground

generate.replanConfirm_one:
Re-plan will discard the current sheet, including your {{count}} approved sample. To ADD more without losing these, use "Generate additional" instead.

Re-plan from scratch anyway?
generate.replanConfirm_other:
Re-plan will discard the current sheet, including your {{count}} approved samples. To ADD more without losing these, use "Generate additional" instead.

Re-plan from scratch anyway?
generate.loraHelpWithBase: Generate with trained LoRA — trigger + shot variation only (no full bible dump); identity from the adapter ({{trigger}} · {{base}}). Re-plan sheet refreshes angles only (keeps vision bible when refs exist). Train LoRA trains weights — it does not rewrite the bible. Use Overview → Sync identity from photos to rescan appearance.
generate.loraHelp: Generate with trained LoRA — trigger + shot variation only (no full bible dump); identity from the adapter ({{trigger}}). Re-plan sheet refreshes angles only (keeps vision bible when refs exist). Train LoRA trains weights — it does not rewrite the bible. Use Overview → Sync identity from photos to rescan appearance.
generate.baseHelp: <bold>Generate base sheet (no LoRA)</bold> — uses the identity bible in prompts. Sync identity from photos on Overview first if you uploaded refs.<bold> Train LoRA</bold> trains the adapter; it does not invent or rewrite the bible.<bold> Re-plan sheet</bold> refreshes shot angles (keeps vision bible when refs exist).
generate.manualEditWarning: Manual bible edit — go to Overview and <bold>Sync identity from photos</bold> before training or generating.
generate.mismatchWarning: Bible may not match your photos — go to Overview and click <bold>Sync identity from photos</bold> before training or generating.
generate.progressPlanned: Planned {{total}} shots — click "Generate images" to render them.
generate.progressPartialFailed: {{done}}/{{total}} rendered · {{failed}} failed — click "Generate images" to finish.
generate.allPromoted: All generated keepers are on the <bold>Training Data</bold> tab (promoted after train). Plan or generate a new batch here when you want more variety.
generate.emptySheet: No reference sheet yet. Click <bold>Plan reference sheet</bold> to plan shot angles (identity from photos / LoRA). The planner will write a frozen identity bible + ~32 varied shot prompts, then <bold>Generate images</bold>.
generate.angleUnverifiedHelp: The vision check could not read this image, so the angle is the planned one and does not count toward framing coverage.
generate.approveToTrain: Approve at least one sample to train from this sheet (or train from Training Data if you already have refs).
generate.trainsOn: Trains on your {{images}} + {{samples}}. On success, approved gens promote to Training Data. Takes hours on a 16GB GPU; runs in the background.

trainingData.replaceImportedConfirm: This character currently uses an imported LoRA. Training will replace it with a new one trained from Cast reference images. Continue?
trainingData.intro: Images for the *next* training run: uploaded references plus approved generated samples. After a successful train, generated keepers promote here permanently and leave the Generate Character sheet. Add new outfits / details then click Train to amend.
trainingData.uploadHelp: Uploads immediately to this cast member.
trainingData.hyperparametersHelp: Train base must match generate base. Z-Image Turbo is the product default and trains + generates; SDXL Legacy is the older path. Steps blank = auto from image count.
trainingData.unsavedSettings: Unsaved changes (Train LoRA also uses and saves them)
trainingData.poolPending: {{images}} (uploads + previously trained) + {{count}} approved generated pending promotion.
trainingData.noUploads_one: No uploads yet — will train on {{count}} approved generated sample; they promote here after train success.
trainingData.noUploads_other: No uploads yet — will train on {{count}} approved generated samples; they promote here after train success.
trainingData.nothingToTrain: Drop in reference images above (or generate + approve some in the Generate Character tab) to enable training.
trainingData.incorporates: Training incorporates the current set. Add new data (outfits, details) later and Train again to amend/evolve.
trainingData.captionsMostlyBare: Captions: {{rich}} rich / {{bare}} bare of {{images}} images — train will VLM-caption bare uploads first
trainingData.busyNote: (health/celery may report busy/503; this is expected for long GPU tasks)
trainingData.failedHelp: Fix the problem, then click “Train LoRA” again. New training data (additional outfits etc.) will be incorporated on the next run (amend).

page.baseTooltip: LoRA train/inference base from Settings → Media models. Must match family at generate time.

versions.title: Trained LoRA
versions.importBlocked: Training is in progress — wait for it to finish before importing.
versions.importHelp: Importing adds a new version for that base; a base the member has none for yet becomes the default. Pick a base's current LoRA default below with "Make default".

regen.title: Regenerate sample
regen.promptHelp: This is the frozen shot prompt; Sync identity / Re-plan updates it. Leave as-is to re-roll the seed.

import.intro: Attach a LoRA checkpoint trained outside Guaardvark (Ostris AI-Toolkit, kohya, or diffusers/PEFT). Only Z-Image Turbo and FLUX.1 Dev layouts are supported.
import.triggerHelp: The token this LoRA was trained on (e.g. caroline_1).
